status: EVERY ENTRY HERE IS active:false, AND THAT IS THE POINT (D196). The owner wants a prediction to be about a real upcoming EVENT; this bank predicts the app's own future numbers instead, which is a different game and not the wanted one. The machinery stands — content, rules, resolver, gate and card — because the day a real-event design arrives it is the same schema with a different rubric kind. Nothing here is served, nothing can be answered, and the resolver skips an inactive call rather than voiding it. Turning one back on is one boolean plus a reseed.
comment: Foresight CALL, tier A (D127, docs/FORESIGHT-CALLS.md). A call is sealed now and graded when it resolves — and tier A is the only tier admitted, because its truth is this app's OWN published aggregate: the grade is arithmetic over v2_question_aggs/{rubric.qid}, the resolver runs no fetch and holds no opinion, and the reader can recompute the outcome from the inputs published beside it. Tiers C (a prose source) and D (the model's memory) never enter this bank; tier B (a machine-readable endpoint) is designed and not built.
authoring: Four rules, and the gate (npm run check:calls) holds the first three:
1. EXACTLY TWO OPTIONS, and they map to the rubric's verdict: index 0
is the call coming true, index 1 is it not. Every card in this bank
asks a yes/no question about a future state of our own numbers.
2. `rubric.qid` names a question that EXISTS in the seeded bank, and
the rubric is executable as written — a rubric that cannot run
today will not run in May either.
3. `resolvesAt` is a UTC day key. The resolver grades on the first
scheduled pass at or after it, and never before.
4. THE ANSWER MUST BE UNKNOWN WHEN THE CARD IS SERVED. This one no
gate can check, because it is a claim about production data rather
than about the file: a call on a threshold the target question has
already crossed is a lookup wearing a prediction's clothes. Write
against a question that is young, a turnout the crowd has not
reached, or a slice split nobody has read yet — and set resolvesAt
far enough out that the aggregate has somewhere to travel.
No provenance rows: like the pulse bank, calls are editorial-only and
outside the farm's lanes (QUESTION-FARM.md hard rule 4 — a machine may
propose an outcome and may never be the reason one is believed).
